title: Collaborative steering: votes from editors and signed-in readers (optional)
description:
Optional Papyrus features for 'web 2' style collaborative steering; editors-only stays the default for every existing site. Pilot publication: Shipped (shipped.anth.us, repo AnthusAI/Shipped-web).

Milestones: (1) steering policy as publication data (who may vote: editors, members, signed-in readers; on what: references, story ideas, articles); (2) reader accounts (Google sign-in via Prospectus accounts, per publication; guests still read); (3) Vote model (subject, voter, value up/down or rating per dimension, timestamp; one per person per subject; materialised tallies; audit); (4) aggregation and ranking (editor quorum/majority/weighted, disagreement queue; reader ranking blending Cyclotron relevance, votes and time decay; editor override/hide); (5) Cyclotron feedback (aggregated labels with per-person attribution; editor and reader signals separate; per-publication choice whether reader votes train; disagreement as a hard-item signal); (6) standard front-end components (vote button, submit-a-link form, new/rising queue page, leaderboards; static pages with an authenticated vote API and periodically refreshed count JSON); (7) moderation and abuse controls (rate limits, account age, report/hide/ban, Humanus on submissions, moderation queue in Administration); (8) monitoring feeds straight into the reader queue. Scoring dimensions for Shipped: real, useful, notable, novel. Document on the Papyrus marketing site when live.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Decisions recorded 2026-10-21 and filed work.
- Submissions are public immediately; moderation is supported and optional per publication (default goal: AI moderation with human override; human moderation to be switched off once AI is trusted).
- Karma: needed. Comments: wanted and solicited; comment text is a steering signal for Cyclotrons and AI.
- How editor and reader scores combine: open exploration, not decided.
- Language-model tasks default to the cheap GPT-6 Luna tier unless stated otherwise.

Epics: reader accounts PPY-1546fc; public submit-a-link PPY-5b8cdc; moderation PPY-af98c7; votes, ratings and karma PPY-73a82d; comments as a steering signal PPY-739cb4; score combination exploration PPY-0b2cbb; live numbers for static sites PPY-64cb48. Documentation story: PPY-ddd434.
Sibling initiative: PPY-428252 (public knowledge base). Biblicus epic: blbs-d380cb. Shipped pilot: ship-b35fa2 (voting story) and ship-4a59a1 (design story).
